Delhi Police Files FIRs Amidst Manipur Violence Probe

The Delhi Police has registered four First Information Reports (FIRs) in connection with the ongoing violence in Manipur. Investigations are focusing on individuals spreading rumors and social media accounts, including those from Pakistan, that are allegedly involved. Separately, reports indicate that explicit images of Manipuri women and child sexual abuse material were being sold through Telegram and WhatsApp groups, leading to the arrest of 13 individuals.
